svg.title: Unlimited envelopes at 0 dB SNR
svg.desc: Whole-band RMS envelope against a 60 Hz narrow-band envelope at f_ref, with and without noise at 0 dB SNR.
svg.text: Why the decoder works per band: 0 dB SNR
hf transmission (silence, tune, sync, header) + AWGN at 0 dB (key-down tone in 2500 Hz), USB receiver 300–2700 Hz.
Both envelopes use the same 25 ms Hann window (60 Hz noise bandwidth); 1.0 = the key-down tone's amplitude A.
narrow band (60 Hz) at f_ref 2132 Hz: magnitude
In 2.4 kHz the noise is as strong as the tone; in 60 Hz it is 16 dB weaker (2400/60).
The decoder measures f_ref and every grid tone in its own narrow band (a Goertzel slot bank), never one wideband envelope.
